policy.keys: catalogue.json is a dict keyed by siglum as Valério 2016's Appendix A prints it; a text with no siglum is keyed by the name it is published under, or by an id.
policy.text: No Cypro-Minoan text ships. Valério 2016, whose Appendix A transcribes the corpus, is a doctoral thesis whose terms allow private research and teaching use only; edition names the edition of record and the Appendix A pages, for a reader with the thesis in hand.
policy.statements: Every metadata statement names its work and page. Where its text is the source's own words it ships as a pointer: text null, pointer true, the cites kept. A table cell ships as its datum, and a remark in it is restated as a note. No quotation of a closed source ships.
policy.identity_controls: Pleiades and Trismegistos ids identify a site; they are never attestations.
